items.title: The Mosaic Co's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: The Mosaic Co (NYSE:MOS) recently announced a total dividend of $0.22 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-10.  This distribution includes a $0.22 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-09-24.  For investors, the ex-dividend date is a critical marker: shareholders must own the stock before this date to qualify for the payment.

items.title: Fertilizer Giants Ready New Plants to Boost U.S. Supplies
items.summary: ​Fertilizer companies are revving their engines to boost supplies of crop nutrients that have been squeezed by the war in the Middle East.  CF Industries, the largest U.S. producer of nitrogen fertilizer, broke ground yesterday on a $4 billion plant.  Separately, farmer co-op CHS and fertilizer maker OCP North America said they plan to build a $450 million production facility focused on phosphate fertilizer.

items.title: MOS Launches Enzyme-Based Residue Management Product
items.summary: Mosaic launches Enzara, an enzyme-based residue solution that works at 32 degree F to speed decomposition and support plant-ready field conditions sooner.

items.title: What Is Mosaic (MOS) Signaling With Its Debt Tender And New Notes?
items.summary: Mosaic (NYSE:MOS) announces cash tender offers to repurchase certain outstanding debt securities, funded by a new fixed income offering. Mosaic highlights potential effects on interest costs, liquidity, and overall balance sheet structure as key aims of the transaction.
